subject: arcadeCabinet
pitch:
Category: Object.
Subject: 1980s arcade cabinet.
Style: synthwave.

spec.name: Neon Cabinet '84
spec.description: A synthwave-styled 1980s upright arcade cabinet with glowing marquee, angled screen, joystick control panel and neon side-art.
spec.layout: Classic upright cabinet. Width 0.76 (x), height 1.85, depth 0.95 (z), +Z is the front. A tall side-profile silhouette: a narrow base plinth at the floor, a front-facing lower body with coin door, a control panel sticking out forward at y~1.0 (a sloped deck, slightly tilted up toward the player), a screen bezel recessed above it leaning back about 12 degrees, and a marquee box on top, with the cabinet back being a plain vertical panel. The sides are dark navy-purple panels with big synthwave art: a magenta-to-cyan striped sun disc, a neon grid horizon and cyan/magenta diagonal stripes, built as small flat parts seated on the side faces (x=+-0.38). Neon cyan and magenta edge trim runs round the side panel edges and the marquee. Glowing parts (marquee, screen, buttons, coin slots, trim) use the glow kit. All surfaces are flat colours.

parts.builds: Main body: two side panels (profile extruded: tall with angled front step down to the control deck, sloped cutout for the screen, rounded back top), back panel, base plinth with kick plate, interior-hidden front lower panel, top cap under the marquee, bottom trim. Side panels are body colour with bodyLight edge bevel strips, neon cyan and magenta edge piping run along front edges and the plinth top. Feet in black. Back has vent slots in bodyDark and a small power-plug panel in metalDark.
parts.attaches: Rests on floor; control deck sits on sideLeft/sideRight at controlDeckFront; marquee seats on top at marqueeCentre; coin door sits at coinDoorCentre.

parts.builds: Synthwave artwork on both outer side faces (x=+-0.385 outward): a big striped sunset disc (yellow to orange to magenta bands with horizontal gaps) built from stacked disc/segment extrudes, a perspective neon grid floor in gridPurple/neonCyan lines below the horizon, two or three diagonal cyan and magenta speed stripes, small white stars and a pair of black mountain silhouettes in zigzag. Mirrored for both sides, kept thin (about 5mm) and seated on the side panels.
parts.attaches: Sits on sideLeft and sideRight mounts, flush on the side panels of cabinetShell.

parts.builds: Sloped control deck jutting forward at y~1.0 to z=0.47: deck slab in bodyLight with neonMagenta front lip and chrome edge trim, a ball-top joystick (base plate, shaft, red ball) on the left of the centre, a cluster of six glowing round buttons in red/blue/yellow on the right, two small player-start buttons, a sticker strip with white text-like blocks and neon lines, and screw heads. Below the deck a front fascia panel with the coin door: two coin slots in coinRed housing with glowing slits, a return tray in black, a metal-dark door frame with neon cyan outline, and a lock.
parts.attaches: Deck back edge at controlDeckBack, front at controlDeckFront; coin door centred at coinDoorCentre on the cabinetShell front.

parts.builds: Recessed CRT section: black bezel frame leaning back about 12 degrees, a glowing screen plane in screenGlow with a synthwave scene (small sun disc, grid lines in screenLine, horizon glow, pixel spaceship and a few alien invaders blocks) and subtle scanline strips, a curved glass look from a slightly larger transparent-looking lighter plate border, bezel inner trim in neonCyan, a speaker grille with slots below the marquee, and the chrome-like corner brackets.
parts.attaches: Centred on screenCentre; bottom meets controlDeckBack, top tucks under marquee.

parts.builds: Top marquee box: a slightly deeper black housing with bevelled front, a bright glowing backlit title panel in neonMagenta to neonCyan bands with big blocky letter-like shapes spelling an arcade title in white and sunYellow built from small boxes, a small sun and grid motif at each end, neon tube outline round the panel edge in neonPink and neonCyan, a top cap with ventilation fins, and two tiny corner lights on top.
parts.attaches: Sits on top of cabinetShell at marqueeCentre; front face above screenAssembly.
